# Qwen3.5 gated-delta reference

The JSON fixture uses only synthetic tensors and is generated by the actual
l2norm, torch_recurrent_gated_delta_rule, and torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule
functions from Hugging Face Transformers at revision
[2f1bc5e321b9a736200a590d6e7743ccdeb60772](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/2f1bc5e321b9a736200a590d6e7743ccdeb60772/src/transformers/models/qwen3_5/modeling_qwen3_5.py).
The source file SHA-256 is
`c4d847b7e809ed2a49611e5afcea8bd0db39de597b67b57ce9753fb65f550de2`.
The source is Apache-2.0; see UPSTREAM-LICENSE.

The generator verifies that hash and executes the upstream functions with
PyTorch. It checks that upstream chunked and recurrent calculations agree,
then records full and chunked outputs, nonzero initial state and zero-state
reset for equal and unequal key/value head counts. To regenerate, run
python tests/fixtures/generate_delta_reference.py MODELING_QWEN3_5.py.

This validates only the f32 recurrent core. It does not validate Qwen's
projections, convolution, normalization and output gate, checkpoint loading,
Runtime state management, BF16 arithmetic, or full-model outputs.
